# 04 Describe

## Purpose

Sample overview, expression distributions, summary tables and exploratory plots.

## Input / Output

+---------------+-----------------------------------+
|               | File                              |
+===============+===================================+
| **Reads**     | `data/03_sample_metadata_aug.rds` |
|               |                                   |
|               | `data/02_dat_clean.tsv`           |
+---------------+-----------------------------------+
| **Writes**    | `Descriptive plots at results/`   |
+---------------+-----------------------------------+

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: 04_setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("R", "99_proj_func.R"))
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| label: 04_load-data
dat_clean <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "02_dat_clean.tsv")
)
metadata_aug <- read_rds(here("data", "03_sample_metadata_aug.rds"))
```

##Analysis

### Sample Composition

#### Count Samples percentage

```{r}
sample_counts <- metadata_aug |>
  count(tissue_group) |>
  mutate(
    percentage = (n/sum(n))*100
  )
```

#### Plot

```{r}
ggplot(sample_counts,aes(
  x=tissue_group,
  y=n,
  fill=tissue_group))+
  geom_col()+
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5)+
  labs(
    title = 'Number of samples in each group',
    x = 'Tissue group',
    y = 'Number of Samples'
  )+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Characteristics distribution

#### Count characteristics percentage

```{r}
characteristic_counts<-metadata_aug |>
  count(characteristic_1) |>
  mutate(
    percentage = (n/sum(n))*100
  )
```

#### Plot

```{r}
ggplot(characteristic_counts,aes(
  x=characteristic_1,
  y=n,
  fill = characteristic_1))+
  geom_col()+
  geom_text(aes(label=n),vjust = -0.3)+
  labs(
    title = 'Number of samples with each characteristic',
    x='characteristics',
    y='Number of samples'
  )+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = 'none')
```

### Expression Summary Statistics

#


###Distribution

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(df_counts, aes(x=expression)) + # df_counts: raw counts matrix, expression: expression values
      geom_histogram(
      bins = 50,
      fill = "skyblue",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3) +
      labs(
      title = "Raw counts",
      subtitle = sample_id,
      x = "Raw count",
      y = "Number of genes"
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p1
```
